newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end higher on firming Swiss franc.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end higher on firming Swiss franc.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Swiss franc bonds ended higher, pulled up by the firmer Swiss franc. But a new 13-year federal bond put some pressure on the longer end as the market had largely been looking for the reopening of a shorter-dated bond. * September CONF ends 50 points higher at 120.68 pct
